newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Sept 9.

text.p: Mitsui Petrochemical Industries Ltd and Mitsui Toatsu Chemicals Inc have reached an agreement to merge in October 1997. Two companies are expected to see their combined sales of about 700 billion yen for the year ending March 31, 1997, which will make the resulting the new company the second-largest chemical maker in Japan, followed by Mitsubishi Chemical Corp.

The U.S. leading semiconductor maker Texas Instruments Inc plans to cut $200 million worth of capital spending to $2.3 billion for the year to December 31, 1996, due to sluggish sales of memory chips.
